<thought>Using the ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 235.1395. Assuming it is the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral mass is ≈ 234.132 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈ 16 % M+1) suggests about 14–16 carbons. A formula that matches the exact mass within a few millidaltons and fits the isotopic intensity is C₁₄H₁₈O₃ (calculated monoisotopic mass = 234.1256 Da). This is the most plausible molecular formula.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H18O3</final_answer>
